name: Mikekarácsonyfa (Hungary)
description: White field with two narrow vertical stripes of light grey and red at the fly edge, charged at the centre of the white with the municipal arms of Mikekarácsonyfa: a red shield with a white church and a fir tree, supported by two black eagles, above a green wreath.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Mikekarácsonyfa arms with eagle supporters and wreath
